relationships.subject: phillyrin
relationships.evidence_quote: Phillyrin engaged the PPARγ signaling pathway to alleviate oxidative stress in kidney stone models, as demonstrated by increased PPARγ expression in phillyrin-treated ethylene glycol-fed rats and CaOx-exposed HK-2 cells

relationships.subject: phillyrin
relationships.evidence_quote: This activation correlated with elevated Nrf2 and HO-1 levels, key elements in oxidative stress repression

relationships.subject: GW9662
relationships.evidence_quote: the PPARγ antagonist GW9662 negated phillyrin-induced enhancements in cell viability

relationships.subject: phillyrin
relationships.evidence_quote: Phillyrin significantly reduced CaOx-induced apoptosis and oxidative stress in HK-2 cells.

key_findings: Phillyrin reduces CaOx-induced apoptosis, oxidative stress and renal crystal deposition in HK-2 cells and rats
